review.reason: Adds a Django signal receiver and conditional heartbeat configuration, plus a wall-clock timeout cap and protected state markers for the autonomous task execution system. P1 establishes a pre-delete hook to cancel workflows before DB cleanup, P2 changes heartbeat signaling, P3 introduces a configurable max runtime and protected terminal states. While complete enforcement and end-to-end behavior are not shown, the implementation and configuration changes demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement to reliability and resource protection.
review.posthog_relevance: Autonomous task execution and agent reliability; prevents dangling workflows and runaway processes.
review.uncertainty: Actual cancellation and wall-clock enforcement behavior not demonstrated; no score assigned.
